rationale: Predefined sensitivity views for the PAH skeletal-muscle protein signature. These are PLANNED subgroup analyses declared before results are read, not post-hoc gene removal. Several higher-in-PAH proteins are myosins, so exercise-related muscle fibre-type composition is a plausible competing explanation for opposition in the contractile subgroup; the fibre view isolates it. Directions follow Malenfant 2015 Table 2 (lower = -1, higher = +1). Reference: DECISIONS.md ADR-0005; interpretation guardrails in README.

views.label: Full 19-protein signature
views.description: All nineteen Table-2 iTRAQ proteins (9 lower + 10 higher). Primary scientific demonstration.

views.label: Lower-in-PAH (9 proteins)
views.description: The nine downregulated proteins (ratio < 1); the committed regression subset. Mitochondrial / OXPHOS / TCA weighted.

views.label: Higher-in-PAH (10 proteins)
views.description: The ten upregulated proteins (ratio > 1); glycolytic and contractile enriched.

views.label: Contractile / fibre-type (myosin) subgroup
views.description: Myosin and contractile proteins whose exercise opposition may reflect fibre-type composition shifts (rat endurance training shifts IIb -> IIa/IIx) rather than a disease-specific effect. Read against fibre markers (MYH1/MYH2/MYH4/MYH7).
